subject: Inbound Webinar: Audience mapping, tracking links & RSVP cadence
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Inbound Webinar: Audience mapping, tracking links & RSVP cadence

Hi team,

We have the webinar draft (content + speakers) locked and the marketing ops calendar shows a launch window the week of Apr 12. I want to finalize: audience segmentation, tracking links, and RSVP reminder cadence so we can hand this to demand gen by next Tuesday. Key asks: 

- Lauren: final target lists and any suppressions (customers vs prospects).
- Marissa: creative for 3 touchpoints (announce, reminder, last-chance) and required UTM matrix.
- Tessa: set up HubSpot journey + GTM tracking; I attached an initial segment workbook for reference.

For the partner co-promo with DevOps Weekly (confirmed), we need to map partner-specific tracking params and a separate RSVP landing link so we can attribute registrations. I sketched a proposed cadence below:

1) Announcement (Apr 12) — HTML invite + partner co-send, track via utm_campaign=inbound-apr12 and partner=devopsweekly
2) Reminder 1 (Apr 19) — targeted to engaged opens; subject line A/B
3) Final reminder (Apr 21) — last-chance 48 hours before event
4) Day-of reminder (Apr 23 morning) — calendar link only for registrants

I propose two RSVP links: primary (redwood.com/webinar/rsvp?src=email) and partner-specific (redwood.com/webinar/rsvp?src=devopsweekly). That will keep landing experience simple while letting us stitch channel in reports.

Please review the attached segments file and ping with changes inline. If we can agree by EOD Tue (Mar 2) I’ll schedule ops to build the HubSpot journey on Wed.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: audience_segments_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inbound Webinar: Audience mapping, tracking links & RSVP cadence

Thanks Karthik — good outline. Quick notes from creative/ops POV: 

- Segments: I trimmed the "engaged" bucket to 30 days of product activity; moved any current trial accounts to exclusion list for the announcement to avoid churn confusion. See tab 'announce_suppressions' in the workbook.
- Creative: I'll produce two subject-line variants for Reminder 1 (technical benefits vs cost-per-token topic). We should A/B at a 50/50 split for deliverability signals.
- UTMs: propose the following matrix for email links:
  * utm_source=email
  * utm_medium=email
  * utm_campaign=inbound-apr12
  * utm_content=announce|reminder1|final
  * partner=devopsweekly (only on partner link)

- Tracking sheet: attached a starter CSV with the link matrix and required HubSpot query params. Tessa — can you confirm HubSpot can automatically append contact-level tracking parameters? If not we will use manual link variations per segment.

Attached: tracking_link_matrix.csv

I also recommend a short teaser SMS for high-value accounts 24 hours before the event (opt-in only). If Ops can support, I'll provide copy.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Demand Gen
Redwood Inference
Attachment: tracking_link_matrix.csv (CSV)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inbound Webinar: Audience mapping, tracking links & RSVP cadence

All — ops can build this. Quick confirmations and timeline: 

- HubSpot: can append contact-level tokens but recommended approach is to generate static per-segment links for clean attribution (we'll create unique link per audience id).
- RSVP landing: will create two forms that map to the same session but set a hidden field "partner_source" so registrations tie back to partner. That keeps analytics simple.
- Automation cadence (proposed):
  * Apr 12 10:00am PST — Announcement send (Audience A + partner co-send)
  * Apr 19 10:00am PST — Reminder 1 (to openers + clicks + engaged in 7d)
  * Apr 21 11:00am PST — Final reminder (all who haven't registered)
  * Apr 23 08:00am PST — Day-of reminder to registrants (calendar + join link)

I uploaded a short timeline PDF with the finalized schedule and components. Also added a column in the drive doc for the exact HubSpot journey names so Marissa's creative team can reference them.

Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Marketing Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: rsvp-reminder-timeline.pdf (PDF)

From: DevOps Weekly <events@devopsweekly.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inbound Webinar: Audience mapping, tracking links & RSVP cadence

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the plan — excited to co-promote. Quick couple of asks from our side before we go live: 

1) Can you provide a partner-specific landing URL that includes our partner id (we prefer partner_id=dw_009) so our system can attribute opens/registrations automatically? The utm approach works but our reporting wants partner_id on the landing URL.
2) Can you confirm we will use a separate RSVP pixel for our email so we can capture the first open event on our side?

If you can send the finalized partner link and the tracking matrix by EOD Thu (Mar 4) we'll schedule our co-send for Apr 12 morning.

Best,
Samantha Lowe
Partnerships Manager
DevOps Weekly
